_about: Par (standard) times at Ascot and how the going changes them; read by the race engine (tools/race-bench) and by the race view's dock (pace against par). Times are rough winning times for a good horse on good ground, from memory: check them against real Ascot results and adjust here. 'speed' scales the par speed on each going; 'sapping' is how much harder the ground makes it to keep going (used by the engine's energy).

pace._about: How the dock judges the pace. Each section the leader runs is compared with par for its length at the race's average par speed; the first section (from a standing start) gets firstSectionExtra seconds of allowance. Ratio = actual time / par time.
